description: Get SEC filing history and company metadata from EDGAR (up to 1000 most recent filings). Requires EDGAR_EMAIL env var.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous response's `pageInfo.endCursor`; omitted = first page

fields.description: Comma-separated list of GraphQL field names to include; omitted = all fields

limit.description: Maximum filings per page; omitted = curated default (25)

name: get_edgar_submissions
title: SEC EDGAR Filing History
